ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Federal Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various types of federal fraud, including visa fraud and childcare fraud, and follow the money to uncover the scope of these crimes.
questions: What are the most common types of federal fraud?
How much money is involved in these crimes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraudulent activities and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of federal programs.
